name: s-kaupat-mcp
description: Find S-kaupat stores, search groceries, fill your shopping lists and order with pickup or home delivery.
long_description:
Lets Claude use the S-kaupat.fi grocery store: choose your store (Prisma, S-market, Alepa, Sale and others) and a pickup time, search and browse products with current prices, read ingredients, allergens and nutrition, and fill your S-kaupat shopping lists. Claude can also place the order for you: it shows the summary with S-kaupat's own total and places the order only after you say yes. Card payment happens on the payment provider's page, which opens in the extension's own window; pay on delivery needs nothing more. Turn "Allow ordering" off in the settings if you only want lists.

Shopping lists need you to log in once to your S-kaupat account in a small window the extension opens (Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome must be installed). Only the login's renewal token is kept, in Windows Credential Manager on Windows.

While Claude uses S-kaupat, a small Edge (or Chrome) window with the S-kaupat site runs minimised in the taskbar; the extension sends its requests from that page and closes the window after 3 idle minutes.

Unofficial: not made or endorsed by S Group.

tools.name: remove_from_shopping_list
tools.description: Take products off a shopping list.

tools.name: find_address

tools.name: get_delivery_options

tools.name: review_order

tools.description: Start or retry the card payment of an order.

tools.name: get_order

tools.name: get_order_items

demo_mode.title: Demo mode
demo_mode.description: Use built-in sample stores and products instead of S-kaupat. Nothing is sent to S-kaupat and no login is needed.

allow_ordering.title: Allow ordering
allow_ordering.description: Let Claude place orders after you confirm the summary. Off: lists and prices only.
